_comment: The three public values a packaged build needs baked in. A packaged app has no .env.local and no shell environment to read, so electron.vite.config.ts compiles these into the main bundle as a fallback (a real environment variable still wins at runtime). Neither Supabase value is a secret: the anon key is published by design and every row is guarded by row-level security. They live here rather than in .env.local so that a CI runner, which has no .env.local, builds an installer that can actually reach the backend.
